introduction: Two infrared wavelengths are translated into color inside a single Spitzer view of the Tarantula Nebula.
observe: Compare the red central region with the surrounding blue structures.
Find the white areas where both mapped wavelengths are present.
explanation: The source links the central red emission to hot gas at 4.5 micrometers and the blue regions to dust containing PAH molecules.
colorMethod: Red and blue distinguish two infrared signals; regions emitting both appear white.
whyItMatters: Even within infrared light, different bands can trace different materials and conditions.
